name: English
tagline: Fit one ant into every colour — no two may share a line or touch.
clash: That ant breaks a rule — see the red tiles
outOfLivesNote: Three wrong placements — give this level another go.
autoXOff: From this level the game stops marking ✕ for you — excluding tiles yourself is the heart of the game. Swipe across tiles to mark them quickly.
solved: Solved — nothing left to work out.
noHint: Nothing can be deduced from here — an ant is probably in the wrong place. Try undoing.
hintPlace: Place an ant on the lit tile
hintExclude: The lit tiles definitely hold no ant
hintReveal: Here's one more ant, in the only place it fits
hintAroundAnt: This ant's row, column and neighbors can't have other ants — exclude them
rules.line: One ant in each row and column
techniqueNotes.1: Some row, column or colour is down to a single cell
techniqueNotes.2: Every option for a colour sits on one line
techniqueNotes.3: K colours fill exactly K lines between them
techniqueNotes.4: A wider lock, or a cell that fails on the spot
techniqueNotes.5: Following an assumption several steps ends in a clash
